solves.reasoning: Grade school science = collection of certainties. Facts won through logical inferences. Process = reducing uncertainties. → certainties-logical-reducing
원문: the practice of science, less about collecting, quite certain → practice-collecting-certain
Facts were hard won(힘들게 얻어진), uncertainties can be greater or lesser, turbulent fluid flow → hard won-greater-turbulent
④ expanding the uncertainties → 과학은 불확실성을 줄이는(reducing) 것. expanding은 정반대 의미
② easily obtained → 원문 hard won. 사실은 쉽게 얻어진 게 아니라 힘들게 얻어진 것
③ concludes(마무리된다) → 원문 remains(여전히 ~이다). 난류 유체 흐름은 아직 끝나지 않고 진행 중
a __ of logical inferences → a succession of logical inferences (일련의 추론)
logical __ based upon many observations → logical inferences (논리적 추론)
the __ fluid flow remains a work in progress → turbulent (난류의). 유체역학은 아직 완전히 이해 안 된 분야
realize = recognize (깨닫다, 인식하다). imagine/forget/deny는 의미 다름
observations(관찰) ≈ examinations(조사/검토). 둘 다 대상을 주의 깊게 살펴보는 행위. assumptions/predictions/conclusions는 다름
certain = sure (확신하는). doubtful(반의어), partial/curious는 의미 다름
greater(더 큰) ↔ smaller(더 작은). 원문에서 greater or lesser로 대비됨
uncertainties(불확실성) ↔ assurances(확신/보증). confusions/questions/ambiguities는 유사어이거나 무관
(A) practice of science = 실행/수행, (B) go for practice before concert = 연습 → (A)실행-(B)연습
'a conclusion reached on the basis of evidence and reasoning' = inference(추론). influence/interference/indifference와 혼동 주의
observe(동사) → observations(명사 복수형). many + 복수 명사 구조. observed(과거형)는 오류
uncertain(형용사) → uncertainties(명사 복수형). the + 명사 구조이며 복수 사용. uncertained는 존재하지 않는 형태
remains __ after more than a century of effort → a work in progress (진행 중인 작업). 아직 완성 안 됨을 의미
less about collecting ... than it is about __ in what we know → reducing the uncertainties (불확실성을 줄이는 것)
